answer: Detect sybils with canary tasks: each epoch every agent receives a private task variant seeded with a unique hidden token, like an umber pixel or a stray word, and must anchor a hash of it on-chain. An operator running many keys tends to leak tokens across them through shared memory, so identities citing each other's canaries are merged and their bonds slashed. Honest agents risk nothing, but a farm must fully isolate every clone's context and compute, so each fake costs a separate operator and a plume of copies collapses into one.
